controls.transitions: horizon * 3000 (same original resource ceiling, completed realized work must compare exactly)

history_boundary: The prior membership candidate remains rejected under its separate study. Profiling supported source cost attribution, not total allocation or decision-quality claims. This method measures the one admitted same-search prototype.
interpretation: Finite same-work local pure-Python installed API comparison for six declared controls on a nonexclusive shared Windows host. No quality/default/reward/full-encounter/CLI/parallel/compiled/general-machine speed claim.

material_rule.aggregate_metric: geometric mean of the six condition median paired ratios
material_rule.condition_adverse_metric: inverse condition median paired ratio; no condition may exceed 1.05
material_rule.condition_metric: median of the five paired ratios in each condition
material_rule.pair_ratio: baseline elapsed search seconds / candidate elapsed search seconds; larger favors candidate

memory_rule.metric: Python tracemalloc peak during the measured installed search in separate cells; not resident memory, total allocations, committed memory or whole process memory

pair_order: baseline,candidate when (condition_index+repetition_index)%2==0, reversed otherwise; serial fresh processes; no conditions pooled by run count
premeasurement_diagnostics: Retained output-admission and literal-storage refusals were repaired before timing without changing this candidate, controls or thresholds. All deciding measurements are complete first attempts.
question: One source candidate: same fixed-work installed MCTS.search cost from request-local reuse of stable physical root-slot Action values
receipt_identity: Ordered physical actions, hex binary64 sums/means, ranked labels/visits, final RNG digest, root pickle-protocol-5 SHA-256, immutable-root flag and actual work/stop are retained for every warmup and measured search.
scope_limits: search-only installed pure-Python API on the declared nonexclusive Windows host
no decision-quality, default, reward, objective or full-encounter improvement claim
no CLI acquisition/startup throughput, compiled or parallel-speed claim
Python tracemalloc peak is not RSS, committed memory, allocation volume or cold-start memory
stopping: One candidate only. No exploratory timing, alternative implementations, cap raises, omitted cases, retuning threshold, selected retry, post-result source correction or manufactured release. A source/trace/admission failure preserves a refused attempt; root resolves a concrete harness error transparently if necessary. A valid deciding miss rejects optimization and retains substantive no-change qualification.
timing_boundary: perf_counter around installed MCTS.search only. Imports, state/MCTS construction, warmup, process creation/assignment/cleanup, input admission and receipt writing excluded. No profiling or intermediate tracing. Includes search's clock checks, fresh legal actions, all selection/rollout/transition/backprop/ranking.
